title: processing_activity.status_changed event payload (v1)
description: PACK-09, ADR-040. Produced by epd2_compliance_service.events. Minimum payload only: identifiers, enum values, timestamps and reason codes. It never carries a document or its bytes, a ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference, an authentication secret, an identity/eID/KYC attribute, a free-text case narrative, or the name of any natural person (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). legal_basis appears as its managed classification value only; it asserts nothing about legal sufficiency.
